using CUDA
using JSON3
import JACC
r = Dict{String,Any}()
probe!(k, f) = try r[k] = f() catch e; r[k] = "ERR: "*sprint(showerror, e) end

probe!("backend_before",  () -> string(JACC.backend()))
probe!("get_backend",     () -> string(JACC.get_backend()))
probe!("default_backend", () -> string(JACC.default_backend()))
probe!("array_type_before", () -> string(JACC.array_type()))
probe!("typeof_array_before", () -> string(typeof(JACC.array(Float32[1,2]))))
probe!("set_backend_methods", () -> replace(string(methods(JACC.set_backend)), "\n"=>" | "))
println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe"=>r)))
